module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.PointwiseOperator
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarRegularRepresentation

public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Spectrum
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap

/-!
# The original regular covariant model from an actual coefficient representation

On the original Lp H 2 Haar carrier, the coefficient at s is
rho(alpha(s inverse)(a)) applied to the original vector at s. The computed
bounded pointwise operator gives this literal formula on all L2 vectors.
The existing Haar left unitaries and these coefficient operators satisfy
the original covariance identity and define the actual regular pair.

The input is the original coefficient star representation, with independent
group, coefficient and Hilbert universes. No regular model, desired output
identity, countability or raw-core faithfulness is assumed. A canonical
source construction may later select an existing faithful GN representation;
source model independence remains a separate obligation.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace

namespace PointNormCStarAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))

/-- The original inverse-action coefficient field on the original Hilbert vectors. -/
def regularCoefficientField (a : A) : G → H →L[ℂ] H := fun s => ρ (α s⁻¹ a)

/-- The original point-norm action makes its coefficient field jointly vector continuous. -/
theorem continuous_regularCoefficientField_action (a : A) :
    Continuous (fun z : G × H => regularCoefficientField α ρ a z.1 z.2) := by
  have hρ : Continuous (ρ : A → (H →L[ℂ] H)) := map_continuous ρ
  exact ((hρ.comp ((α.continuous_orbit a).comp continuous_inv)).comp
    continuous_fst).clm_apply continuous_snd

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] in
/-- The original coefficient norm uniformly bounds this actual operator field. -/
theorem norm_regularCoefficientField_le (a : A) (s : G) :
    ‖regularCoefficientField α ρ a s‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
  change ‖ρ (α s⁻¹ a)‖ ≤ ‖a‖
  exact (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le ρ (α s⁻¹ a)).trans (α.norm_apply s⁻¹ a).le

variable [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

/-- The actual original regular coefficient operator on the same vector-valued L2 carrier. -/
def regularCoefficientOperator (a : A) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
  HaarL2.pointwiseOperator (regularCoefficientField α ρ a)
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField_action α ρ a) μ ‖a‖
    (norm_regularCoefficientField_le α ρ a)

/-- Every original L2 vector retains the printed inverse-action coefficient formula. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq (a : A) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ =ᵐ[μ] fun s : G => ρ (α s⁻¹ a) (ξ s) :=
  HaarL2.pointwiseOperator_ae_eq (regularCoefficientField α ρ a)
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField_action α ρ a) μ ‖a‖
    (norm_regularCoefficientField_le α ρ a) ξ

/-- The original coefficient norm bounds every actual L2 image. -/
theorem norm_regularCoefficientOperator_apply_le (a : A) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    ‖regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖ξ‖ :=
  HaarL2.pointwiseOperator_norm_apply_le (regularCoefficientField α ρ a)
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField_action α ρ a) μ ‖a‖
    (norm_regularCoefficientField_le α ρ a) ξ

/-- The actual regular coefficient operators preserve original coefficient addition. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_add (a b : A) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a + b) =
      regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a + regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (a + b) ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ b ξ,
    Lp.coeFn_add (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ) (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b ξ)]
    with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a + b) ξ s =
    (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ + regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₄, Pi.add_apply, h₂, h₃, map_add (α.aut s⁻¹), map_add ρ]
  rfl

/-- The actual regular coefficient operators preserve original complex scaling. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_smul (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (c • a) = c • regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (c • a) ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a ξ,
    Lp.coeFn_smul c (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ)] with s h₁ h₂ h₃
  change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (c • a) ξ s =
    (c • regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₃, Pi.smul_apply, h₂, map_smul (α.aut s⁻¹), map_smul ρ]
  rfl

/-- The actual regular coefficient operators preserve original coefficient multiplication. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_mul (a b : A) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a * b) =
      regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a * regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (a * b) ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b ξ),
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ b ξ] with s h₁ h₂ h₃
  change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a * b) ξ s =
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ b ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, map_mul (α.aut s⁻¹), map_mul ρ]
  rfl

/-- The original coefficient involution gives the actual L2 operator adjoint. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_star (a : A) :
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (star a) = star (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff
    (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (star a)) (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a)).mpr
  intro ξ η
  rw [L2.inner_def, L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (star a) ξ,
    regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a η] with s h₁ h₂
  rw [h₁, h₂, StarHomClass.map_star (α.aut s⁻¹), StarHomClass.map_star ρ]
  change ⟪star (ρ (α s⁻¹ a)) (ξ s), η s⟫_ℂ = ⟪ξ s, ρ (α s⁻¹ a) (η s)⟫_ℂ
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (ρ (α s⁻¹ a)) (η s) (ξ s)

/-- The computed original regular coefficient representation is a nonunital complex star hom. -/
def regularCoefficientHom : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) where
  toFun := regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ
  map_zero' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (0 : A) ξ,
      Lp.coeFn_zero H 2 μ] with s h₁ h₂
    change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (0 : A) ξ s = (0 : Lp H 2 μ) s
    rw [h₁, h₂, map_zero (α.aut s⁻¹), map_zero ρ]
    rfl
  map_add' := regularCoefficientOperator_add α ρ μ
  map_mul' := regularCoefficientOperator_mul α ρ μ
  map_smul' := regularCoefficientOperator_smul α ρ μ
  map_star' := regularCoefficientOperator_star α ρ μ

variable [μ.IsHaarMeasure]

/-- The original Haar left translations and coefficient operators satisfy original covariance. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_covariance (g : G) (a : A) :
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) * regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a *
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) = regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (α g a) := by
  rw [StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.star_haarLeftRegular]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  let L (h : G) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H h
  let η := L g⁻¹ ξ
  have houter := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g
    (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a η)
  have hcoefficient := regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ a η
  have hinner := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g⁻¹ ξ
  have hpres : MeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ := measurePreserving_smul g⁻¹ μ
  have hquasi : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ :=
    ⟨hpres.measurable, by rw [hpres.map_eq]⟩
  have hcoefficient' := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hcoefficient
  have hinner' := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hinner
  filter_upwards [houter, hcoefficient', hinner', regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq α ρ μ (α g a) ξ]
    with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  change L g (regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a (L g⁻¹ ξ)) s =
    regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (α g a) ξ s
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₂ h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  simp only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_inv_cancel_left]
  exact congrArg (fun b : A => ρ b (ξ s)) (α.apply_mul s⁻¹ g a)

/-- The actual original regular covariant pair on the original vector-valued Haar L2 carrier. -/
def regularCovariantRepresentation : CovariantRepresentation α (Lp H 2 μ) where
  algebra := regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ
  group := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H
  covariance := by
    intro g a
    change (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) * regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a *
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) = regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (α g a)
    exact regularCoefficientOperator_covariance α ρ μ g a

end

end PointNormCStarAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.NonUnitalRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarRegularCovariantModel

/-!
# The canonical regular Haar pair from the strict nonunital GN construction

Select the actual same-universe Hilbert representation supplied by the
proved nonunital Gelfand--Naimark construction. Its original dictionaries,
injective coefficient map share the single neutral GN packet and choice.
The original coefficient norm follows from the neutral norm theorem. The
verified original regular construction then gives the coefficient and
Haar translation pair on that selected Hilbert space's actual Lp carrier.

The canonical endpoint has no coefficient-representation or regular-model
input. The group and coefficient universes remain independent, and zero
coefficient algebras are permitted. Independence of the resulting source
model and raw-core faithfulness remain separate theorem obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace PointNormCStarAction

open MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.NonUnitalRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

/-- The actual source-sized coefficient Hilbert space selected from strict GN data. -/
abbrev CanonicalCoefficientSpace (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] : Type uA :=
  (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).space

instance instCanonicalCoefficientNormed (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    NormedAddCommGroup (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) := (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).normed

instance instCanonicalCoefficientInner (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    InnerProductSpace ℂ (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) := (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).inner

instance instCanonicalCoefficientComplete (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    CompleteSpace (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) := (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).complete

/-- The canonical coefficient representation is the actual selected strict GN map. -/
def canonicalCoefficientRepresentation (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A →L[ℂ] CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) :=
  (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).representation

/-- The canonical selected coefficient map is genuinely faithful. -/
theorem canonicalCoefficientRepresentation_injective (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    Function.Injective (canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A) :=
  (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).injective_representation

/-- The canonical coefficient operator retains the original algebra norm. -/
theorem norm_canonicalCoefficientRepresentation (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] (a : A) :
    ‖canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A a‖ = ‖a‖ :=
  (faithfulHilbertRepresentationData A).norm_representation a

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The actual original Haar L2 carrier of the internally selected canonical GN coefficient space. -/
abbrev CanonicalRegularSpace := Lp (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) 2 μ

/-- The actual canonical regular covariant pair, with no external coefficient-model input. -/
def canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation : CovariantRepresentation α (CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :=
  α.regularCovariantRepresentation (canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A) μ

/-- The canonical regular coefficient keeps the original inverse-action formula on every vector. -/
theorem canonicalRegularCoefficient_ae_eq (a : A) (ξ : CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :
    (canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation μ α).algebra a ξ =ᵐ[μ]
      fun s : G => canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A (α s⁻¹ a) (ξ s) :=
  α.regularCoefficientOperator_ae_eq (canonicalCoefficientRepresentation A) μ a ξ

/-- The canonical group's actual vector action is the original Haar inverse left translation. -/
theorem canonicalRegularGroup_ae_eq (g : G) (ξ : CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) :
    ((canonicalRegularCovariantRepresentation μ α).group g :
        CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ →L[ℂ] CanonicalRegularSpace (A := A) μ) ξ =ᵐ[μ]
      fun s : G => ξ (g⁻¹ * s) :=
  StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ (CanonicalCoefficientSpace A) g ξ

end

end PointNormCStarAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarRegularCovariantModel

/-!
# Faithful original regular coefficient operators on the actual Haar L2 carrier

An actual zero regular coefficient operator annihilates every original
compact-support vector. The open-positive compact-support inclusion recovers
its literal pointwise values. Test a compact scalar bump nonzero at the
identity to recover the original coefficient operator rho(a).

A faithful original coefficient representation therefore gives a faithful
regular coefficient homomorphism, and the C-star homomorphism theorem gives
its original coefficient norm. This supplies faithful regular coefficient
maps for the reduced/full comparison without an assumed regular model or
source norm equality. The canonical GN selection is a separate constructor.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported CStarAlgebra

namespace PointNormCStarAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular] [μ.IsHaarMeasure]

/-- A zero original regular coefficient operator has zero original coefficient value under rho. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOperator_eq_zero_implies (a : A)
    (hZero : regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a = 0) : ρ a = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψcomp, _hψnonneg, hψone⟩ := exists_continuous_nonneg_pos (1 : G)
  let F : C_c(G, H) :=
    { toFun s := ((ψ s : ℝ) : ℂ) • ξ
      continuous_toFun :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ψ.continuous).smul continuous_const
      hasCompactSupport' := hψcomp.comp_left
        (g := fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ) • ξ) (by simp) }
  let T := regularCoefficientField α ρ a
  let hT := continuous_regularCoefficientField_action α ρ a
  let J : C_c(G, H) := HaarL2.pointwiseCompactSupport T hT F
  have hImage : HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ J = 0 := by
    rw [← HaarL2.pointwiseOperator_apply_compactSupport T hT μ ‖a‖
      (norm_regularCoefficientField_le α ρ a) F]
    change regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ a (HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ F) = 0
    rw [hZero]
    rfl
  have hJ : J = 0 := HaarL2.injective_compactSupportInclusion μ
    (hImage.trans (map_zero (HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion (H := H) μ)).symm)
  have hValue := congrArg (fun f : C_c(G, H) => f (1 : G)) hJ
  change ρ (α (1 : G)⁻¹ a) (((ψ (1 : G) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ξ) = 0 at hValue
  rw [inv_one, α.apply_one, map_smul] at hValue
  have hScalar : ((ψ (1 : G) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hψone
    simpa using congrArg Complex.re h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hValue).resolve_left hScalar

/-- A faithful original coefficient representation gives a faithful actual regular coefficient map. -/
theorem regularCoefficientHom_injective (hρ : Function.Injective ρ) :
    Function.Injective (regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ) := by
  intro a b hab
  apply hρ
  have hZero : regularCoefficientOperator α ρ μ (a - b) = 0 := by
    change regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ (a - b) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  have hOriginal := regularCoefficientOperator_eq_zero_implies α ρ μ (a - b) hZero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [map_sub] using hOriginal)

/-- The actual faithful regular coefficient homomorphism has the original source C-star norm. -/
theorem norm_regularCoefficientHom (hρ : Function.Injective ρ) (a : A) :
    ‖regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ a‖ = ‖a‖ :=
  NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map (regularCoefficientHom α ρ μ)
    (regularCoefficientHom_injective α ρ μ hρ) a

end

end PointNormCStarAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.TransferInstance
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.TransferInstance

/-!
# The original measure- and action-indexed Haar core carrier

The carrier is a one-field wrapper of the literal original C_c(G,A) function.
Both the given measure and coefficient action are indices, so different Haar
measures or actions have their own future twisted algebra structures. Exact
maps to and from C_c transport only the original additive and complex-module
data and function evaluation. Multiplication, star and norm are not inherited.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Monoid G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual original compact-support function, indexed by its measure and coefficient action. -/
structure Carrier (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) where
  /-- The same literal source compactly supported continuous coefficient function. -/
  toCc : C_c(G, A)

variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- Read the original compact-support function without changing its values or topology. -/
def toCc (f : Carrier μ α) : C_c(G, A) := f.toCc

/-- Put the original compact-support function into its actual measure/action-indexed carrier. -/
def fromCc (f : C_c(G, A)) : Carrier μ α := ⟨f⟩

/-- The wrapper retains every original compact-support function exactly. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCc_fromCc (f : C_c(G, A)) : toCc μ α (fromCc μ α f) = f :=
  rfl

/-- The exact original function determines the same indexed wrapper. -/
@[simp]
theorem fromCc_toCc (f : Carrier μ α) : fromCc μ α (toCc μ α f) = f := by
  cases f
  rfl

/-- The measure/action-indexed carrier is exactly the original function type as a set of values. -/
def equivCc : Carrier μ α ≃ C_c(G, A) where
  toFun := toCc μ α
  invFun := fromCc μ α
  left_inv := fromCc_toCc μ α
  right_inv := toCc_fromCc μ α

/-- Only the original pointwise additive group is transported to the indexed core. -/
instance instAddCommGroupCarrier : AddCommGroup (Carrier μ α) :=
  (equivCc μ α).addCommGroup

/-- Only the original pointwise complex module is transported to the indexed core. -/
instance instModuleCarrier : Module ℂ (Carrier μ α) := by
  let e : Carrier μ α ≃+ C_c(G, A) := (equivCc μ α).addEquiv
  exact e.module ℂ

/-- Evaluation is the literal original compact-support coefficient value. -/
instance instCoeFunCarrier : CoeFun (Carrier μ α) (fun _ => G → A) :=
  ⟨fun f => (toCc μ α f : G → A)⟩

/-- The indexed additive zero is the same original zero coefficient function. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCc_zero : toCc μ α (0 : Carrier μ α) = 0 :=
  rfl

/-- Indexed addition retains the original pointwise additive coefficient function. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCc_add (f g : Carrier μ α) : toCc μ α (f + g) = toCc μ α f + toCc μ α g :=
  rfl

/-- Indexed complex scaling retains the original scalar coefficient function. -/
@[simp]
theorem toCc_smul (c : ℂ) (f : Carrier μ α) : toCc μ α (c • f) = c • toCc μ α f :=
  rfl

/-- The indexed core functions agree precisely when all original coefficient values agree. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {f g : Carrier μ α} (h : ∀ s : G, f s = g s) : f = g := by
  apply (equivCc μ α).injective
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  exact h s

end

end HaarTwistedCore

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CrossedProduct.HaarTwistedCore.Basic

/-!
# The literal original Haar twisted convolution

The source functions retain their original compact supports and coefficient
values. Parameter continuity uses scalar factor one and the existing compact
bilinear integral statement. The source algebra is nonunital, including zero;
no coefficient identity or global countability assumption enters the kernel.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CompactlySupported Topology Pointwise

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original left-Haar twisted convolution integrand at parameter s and integration coordinate t. -/
def kernel (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s t : G) : A :=
  f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s))

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The original source integrand is jointly continuous in its parameter and Haar coordinate. -/
theorem continuous_kernel (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) :
    Continuous (Function.uncurry (kernel α f g)) := by
  exact ((map_continuous f).comp continuous_snd).mul
    (α.continuous_apply continuous_snd
      ((map_continuous g).comp (continuous_snd.inv.mul continuous_fst)))

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The original integrand is zero outside the original first compact support. -/
theorem kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)
    (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s t : G) (ht : t ∉ tsupport f) : kernel α f g s t = 0 := by
  rw [kernel, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport ht, zero_mul]

variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The exact original kernel is integrable for every original source parameter. -/
theorem integrable_kernel (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    Integrable (kernel α f g s) μ := by
  have hc : Continuous (kernel α f g s) :=
    (continuous_kernel α f g).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hcomp : HasCompactSupport (kernel α f g s) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' f.hasCompactSupport (isClosed_tsupport f)
      (kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α f g s)
  exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcomp

/-- The actual original convolution coefficient is its printed left-Haar integral. -/
def convolutionValue (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) : A :=
  letI : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  ∫ t : G, kernel α f g s t ∂μ

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Outside the product of original supports, every source convolution coefficient vanishes. -/
theorem convolutionValue_zero_of_notMem_product (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)
    (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) (hs : s ∉ tsupport f * tsupport g) :
    convolutionValue μ α f g s = 0 := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
    change kernel α f g s t = 0
    by_cases ht : t ∈ tsupport f
    · have hg : t⁻¹ * s ∉ tsupport g := by
        intro hgt
        apply hs
        simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul ht hgt
      rw [kernel, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hg, α.apply_zero, mul_zero]
    · exact kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α f g s t ht

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Scalar-one compact parameter integration makes the original convolution continuous. -/
theorem continuous_convolutionValue (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) :
    Continuous (convolutionValue μ α f g) := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let L : ℂ →L[ℂ] A →L[ℂ] A := ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℂ ℂ
  have hq : IntegrableOn (fun _ : G => (1 : ℂ)) (tsupport f) μ :=
    integrableOn_const f.hasCompactSupport.measure_ne_top
  have hc :=
    _root_.continuousOn_integral_bilinear_of_locally_integrable_of_compact_support
      L f.hasCompactSupport (continuous_kernel α f g).continuousOn
      (fun s t _ ht => kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α f g s t ht) hq
      (s := Set.univ)
  have hfun : (fun s : G => ∫ t : G, L (1 : ℂ) (kernel α f g s t) ∂μ) =
      convolutionValue μ α f g := by
    funext s
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      dsimp only [L]
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, one_smul]
  rw [hfun] at hc
  exact continuousOn_univ.mp hc

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The convolution's actual topological support lies in the product of the original supports. -/
theorem tsupport_convolutionValue_subset (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) :
    tsupport (convolutionValue μ α f g) ⊆ tsupport f * tsupport g := by
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro s hs
    by_contra hnot
    exact hs (convolutionValue_zero_of_notMem_product μ α f g s hnot)
  · exact (isClosed_tsupport g).mul_left_of_isCompact f.hasCompactSupport

/-- The literal original convolution as a compactly supported continuous coefficient function. -/
def ccConvolution (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) : C_c(G, A) where
  toFun := convolutionValue μ α f g
  continuous_toFun := continuous_convolutionValue μ α f g
  hasCompactSupport' :=
    (f.hasCompactSupport.mul g.hasCompactSupport).of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_tsupport _) (tsupport_convolutionValue_subset μ α f g)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The C_c convolution retains every original coefficient integral. -/
theorem ccConvolution_apply (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    ccConvolution μ α f g s =
      letI : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
      ∫ t : G, f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ :=
  rfl

/-- The original Haar convolution on the same measure/action-indexed source function carrier. -/
def convolution (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : Carrier μ α) : Carrier μ α :=
  fromCc μ α (ccConvolution μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g))

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every indexed convolution value is the literal printed original Haar coefficient. -/
theorem convolution_apply (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    convolution μ α f g s =
      letI : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
      ∫ t : G, f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)) ∂μ :=
  rfl

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Zero on the left acts by the actual zero convolution. -/
theorem convolution_zero_left (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (g : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α 0 g = 0 := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [convolution_apply]
  simp only [toCc_zero, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply, zero_mul, integral_zero]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Zero on the right acts by the actual zero convolution. -/
theorem convolution_zero_right (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α f 0 = 0 := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [convolution_apply]
  simp only [toCc_zero, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply,
    α.apply_zero, mul_zero, integral_zero]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original convolution is additive in its first coefficient function. -/
theorem convolution_add_left (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g h : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α (f + g) h = convolution μ α f h + convolution μ α g h := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  have hk : (fun t : G => (f + g) t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      (fun t : G => f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s)) + g t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s))) := by
    funext t
    rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply, add_mul]
  rw [hk]
  exact integral_add (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s)
    (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α g) (toCc μ α h) s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original convolution is additive in its second coefficient function. -/
theorem convolution_add_right (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g h : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α f (g + h) = convolution μ α f g + convolution μ α f h := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  have hk : (fun t : G => f t * α t ((g + h) (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      (fun t : G => f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)) + f t * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s))) := by
    funext t
    rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply, α.apply_add, mul_add]
  rw [hk]
  exact integral_add (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s)
    (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α h) s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original convolution is complex linear in its first coefficient function. -/
theorem convolution_smul_left (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (c : ℂ) (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α (c • f) g = c • convolution μ α f g := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply]
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  let L : A →L[ℂ] A := c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ A
  have hL (z : A) : L z = c • z := rfl
  have hk : (fun t : G => (c • f) t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      (fun t : G => L (f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)))) := by
    funext t
    rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, hL]
    exact smul_mul_assoc _ _ _
  rw [hk]
  simpa only [hL, kernel] using
    L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original convolution is complex linear in its second coefficient function. -/
theorem convolution_smul_right (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (c : ℂ) (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α f (c • g) = c • convolution μ α f g := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply]
  rw [convolution_apply, convolution_apply]
  let L : A →L[ℂ] A := c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ A
  have hL (z : A) : L z = c • z := rfl
  have hk : (fun t : G => f t * α t ((c • g) (t⁻¹ * s))) =
      (fun t : G => L (f t * α t (g (t⁻¹ * s)))) := by
    funext t
    rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, α.apply_smul, mul_smul_comm, hL]
  rw [hk]
  simpa only [hL, kernel] using
    L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) s)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- Original Haar convolution coefficients associate by compact Fubini and literal left translation. -/
theorem convolutionValue_assoc (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g h : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    convolutionValue μ α (ccConvolution μ α f g) h s =
      convolutionValue μ α f (ccConvolution μ α g h) s := by
  let : NormedSpace ℝ A := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ A
  let K : G → G → A := fun t r => kernel α f g t r * α t (h (t⁻¹ * s))
  have hKcont : Continuous K.uncurry :=
    (continuous_kernel α f g).mul
      (α.continuous_apply continuous_fst
        ((map_continuous h).comp (continuous_fst.inv.mul_const s)))
  let Sfg : Set G := tsupport f * tsupport g
  have hSfgcompact : IsCompact Sfg := f.hasCompactSupport.mul g.hasCompactSupport
  have hSfgclosed : IsClosed Sfg :=
    (isClosed_tsupport g).mul_left_of_isCompact f.hasCompactSupport
  have hKzero (p : G × G) (hp : p ∉ Sfg ×ˢ tsupport f) : K p.1 p.2 = 0 := by
    by_cases hr : p.2 ∈ tsupport f
    · have ht : p.1 ∉ Sfg := fun ht => hp ⟨ht, hr⟩
      have hg : p.2⁻¹ * p.1 ∉ tsupport g := by
        intro hgp
        apply ht
        simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using Set.mul_mem_mul hr hgp
      simp only [K, kernel, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hg, α.apply_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · simp only [K, kernel_zero_of_notMem_tsupport_left α f g p.1 p.2 hr, zero_mul]
  have hKcompact : HasCompactSupport K.uncurry :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' (hSfgcompact.prod f.hasCompactSupport)
      (hSfgclosed.prod (isClosed_tsupport f)) hKzero
  have hLeft : convolutionValue μ α (ccConvolution μ α f g) h s =
      ∫ t : G, (∫ r : G, K t r ∂μ) ∂μ := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      let R : A →L[ℂ] A := (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip (α t (h (t⁻¹ * s)))
      have hR := R.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α f g t)
      rw [kernel, ccConvolution_apply]
      simpa only [K, kernel, R,
        ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply'] using hR.symm
  have hSwap : (∫ t : G, (∫ r : G, K t r ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      ∫ r : G, (∫ t : G, K t r ∂μ) ∂μ :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap_of_hasCompactSupport
      hKcont hKcompact
  have hRight : (∫ r : G, (∫ t : G, K t r ∂μ) ∂μ) =
      convolutionValue μ α f (ccConvolution μ α g h) s := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun r => by
      let a : A →L[ℂ] A :=
        ⟨LinearMap.ofClass (α.aut r), (StarAlgEquiv.isometry (α.aut r)).continuous⟩
      let L : A →L[ℂ] A := (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A (f r)).comp a
      have hL (z : A) : L z = f r * α r z := rfl
      have hPoint (u : G) : K (r * u) r = L (kernel α g h (r⁻¹ * s) u) := by
        calc
          K (r * u) r = (f r * α r (g u)) *
              α r (α u (h (u⁻¹ * (r⁻¹ * s)))) := by
            simp only [K, kernel, inv_mul_cancel_left, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, α.apply_mul]
          _ = f r * (α r (g u) * α r (α u (h (u⁻¹ * (r⁻¹ * s))))) :=
            mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ = f r * α r (g u * α u (h (u⁻¹ * (r⁻¹ * s)))) :=
            congrArg (fun z : A => f r * z) (α.apply_mul_elem r _ _).symm
          _ = L (kernel α g h (r⁻¹ * s) u) := (hL _).symm
      calc
        (∫ t : G, K t r ∂μ) = ∫ u : G, K (r * u) r ∂μ :=
          (integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := μ) (fun t : G => K t r) r).symm
        _ = ∫ u : G, L (kernel α g h (r⁻¹ * s) u) ∂μ :=
          integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall hPoint)
        _ = L (∫ u : G, kernel α g h (r⁻¹ * s) u ∂μ) :=
          L.integral_comp_comm (integrable_kernel μ α g h (r⁻¹ * s))
        _ = kernel α f (ccConvolution μ α g h) s r := by
          rw [hL]
          rfl
  exact hLeft.trans (hSwap.trans hRight)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [μ.Regular] in
/-- The same original measure/action-indexed Haar convolution is associative. -/
theorem convolution_assoc (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f g h : Carrier μ α) :
    convolution μ α (convolution μ α f g) h = convolution μ α f (convolution μ α g h) := by
  apply ext μ α
  intro s
  change convolutionValue μ α
      (ccConvolution μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g)) (toCc μ α h) s =
    convolutionValue μ α (toCc μ α f)
      (ccConvolution μ α (toCc μ α g) (toCc μ α h)) s
  exact convolutionValue_assoc μ α (toCc μ α f) (toCc μ α g) (toCc μ α h) s

end

/-!
# The original Haar twisted involution

The coefficient at `s` is the positive-real modular weight times the action at `s`
of the adjoint coefficient at `s⁻¹`. The positive-real weight is written through
its canonical complex scalar image, using exactly the original complex module.
Only the additive, involutive and conjugate-linear structures are installed here;
the convolution multiplication has a separate owner.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported NNReal Pointwise CStarAlgebra

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The literal modularly weighted adjoint coefficient function, with its original
compact support and continuous action. -/
def crossedStarCc (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f : C_c(G, A)) : C_c(G, A) where
  toFun s := ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) • α s (star (f s⁻¹))
  continuous_toFun := by
    have hδ : Continuous (fun s : G => ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp Measure.continuous_modularCharacter)
    exact hδ.smul (α.continuous_apply continuous_id ((map_continuous f).comp continuous_inv).star)
  hasCompactSupport' := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro f.hasCompactSupport.inv ?_
    intro s hs
    have hzero : f s⁻¹ = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      apply hs
      change s⁻¹ ∈ tsupport (f : G → A)
      exact subset_closure hne
    simp only [hzero, star_zero, PointNormCStarAction.apply_zero, smul_zero]

omit [MeasurableSpace G] in
/-- Evaluation of the original compact-support involution retains its Haar modular factor. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedStarCc_apply (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f : C_c(G, A)) (s : G) :
    crossedStarCc α f s = ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) • α s (star (f s⁻¹)) :=
  rfl

omit [MeasurableSpace G] in
/-- Involuting a coefficient can only invert its original topological support. -/
theorem tsupport_crossedStarCc_subset (α : PointNormCStarAction G A) (f : C_c(G, A)) :
    tsupport (crossedStarCc α f : G → A) ⊆ (tsupport (f : G → A))⁻¹ := by
  refine closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport (f : G → A)).inv
  intro s hs
  have hne : f s⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hs
    simp only [crossedStarCc_apply, hzero, star_zero, PointNormCStarAction.apply_zero, smul_zero]
  change s⁻¹ ∈ tsupport (f : G → A)
  exact subset_closure hne

variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The Haar twisted involution on the same measure- and action-indexed coefficient carrier. -/
def crossedStar (f : Carrier μ α) : Carrier μ α :=
  fromCc μ α (crossedStarCc α (toCc μ α f))

/-- The indexed involution has the exact original modularly weighted coefficient value. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedStar_apply (f : Carrier μ α) (s : G) :
    crossedStar μ α f s = ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) • α s (star (f s⁻¹)) :=
  rfl

/-- The original twisted involution preserves addition of coefficient functions. -/
theorem crossedStar_add (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (f + g) = crossedStar μ α f + crossedStar μ α g := by
  apply (equivCc μ α).injective
  change toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α (f + g)) =
    toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α f + crossedStar μ α g)
  rw [toCc_add]
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  simp only [crossedStar, toCc_fromCc, crossedStarCc_apply, toCc_add,
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply, star_add, PointNormCStarAction.apply_add, smul_add]

/-- The original twisted involution is conjugate-linear for the original complex module. -/
theorem crossedStar_smul (c : ℂ) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (c • f) = star c • crossedStar μ α f := by
  apply (equivCc μ α).injective
  change toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α (c • f)) = toCc μ α (star c • crossedStar μ α f)
  rw [toCc_smul]
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  simp only [crossedStar, toCc_fromCc, crossedStarCc_apply, toCc_smul,
    CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, star_smul, PointNormCStarAction.apply_smul]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

/-- Applying the source involution twice restores the original coefficient function. -/
theorem crossedStar_crossedStar (f : Carrier μ α) :
    crossedStar μ α (crossedStar μ α f) = f := by
  apply (equivCc μ α).injective
  change toCc μ α (crossedStar μ α (crossedStar μ α f)) = toCc μ α f
  apply CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  have hδ : ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ((Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1 := by
    have h : Measure.modularCharacter s * Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]
    have hreal : (Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) *
        (Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  have hstarδ : star ((Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ((Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp
  simp only [crossedStar, toCc_fromCc, crossedStarCc_apply, inv_inv]
  change ((Measure.modularCharacter s : ℝ) : ℂ) •
    α s (star (((Measure.modularCharacter s⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) • α s⁻¹ (star (f s)))) = f s
  rw [star_smul, hstarδ, ← PointNormCStarAction.apply_star, star_star,
    PointNormCStarAction.apply_smul, PointNormCStarAction.apply_apply_inv, ← mul_smul, hδ, one_smul]

/-- The core's star is the original Haar twisted involution. -/
instance instStarCarrier : Star (Carrier μ α) :=
  ⟨crossedStar μ α⟩

/-- The original modular character and inverse action make the core's star involutive. -/
instance instInvolutiveStarCarrier : InvolutiveStar (Carrier μ α) where
  star_involutive := crossedStar_crossedStar μ α

/-- The original additive coefficient group has its source twisted star structure. -/
instance instStarAddMonoidCarrier : StarAddMonoid (Carrier μ α) where
  star_add := crossedStar_add μ α

/-- The original complex module has its source conjugate-linear twisted star structure. -/
instance instStarModuleCarrier : StarModule ℂ (Carrier μ α) where
  star_smul := crossedStar_smul μ α

end

/-!
# The original Haar-core L1 gauge

The auxiliary gauge is the integral of the norm of the original compactly
supported coefficient function. It uses the original coefficient norm and
complex module; no norm or metric is installed on the raw Haar core.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CompactlySupported

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Monoid G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- The literal integral of the original coefficient norm on the indexed Haar core. -/
def l1Gauge (f : Carrier μ α) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s : G, ‖f s‖ ∂μ

/-- The original coefficient-norm integral is nonnegative. -/
theorem l1Gauge_nonneg (f : Carrier μ α) : 0 ≤ l1Gauge μ α f :=
  integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _

/-- The indexed zero coefficient function has zero auxiliary L1 gauge. -/
@[simp]
theorem l1Gauge_zero : l1Gauge μ α (0 : Carrier μ α) = 0 := by
  simp only [l1Gauge, toCc_zero, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply, norm_zero,
    integral_zero]

/-- Original complex coefficient scaling multiplies the gauge by the scalar norm. -/
theorem l1Gauge_smul (c : ℂ) (f : Carrier μ α) :
    l1Gauge μ α (c • f) = ‖c‖ * l1Gauge μ α f := by
  have hfun : (fun s : G => ‖(c • f) s‖) = fun s : G => ‖c‖ * ‖f s‖ := by
    funext s
    rw [toCc_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, norm_smul]
  unfold l1Gauge
  rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]

/-- Taking the additive inverse preserves the same coefficient-norm integral. -/
@[simp]
theorem l1Gauge_neg (f : Carrier μ α) : l1Gauge μ α (-f) = l1Gauge μ α f := by
  rw [← neg_one_smul ℂ f, l1Gauge_smul, norm_neg, norm_one, one_mul]

variable [BorelSpace G] [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]

omit [Monoid G] in
/-- The norm of a genuine compactly supported continuous coefficient is integrable. -/
private theorem l1NormIntegrable (f : C_c(G, A)) :
    Integrable (fun s : G => ‖f s‖) μ := by
  have hcomp : HasCompactSupport (fun s : G => ‖f s‖) :=
    f.hasCompactSupport.comp_left (g := fun a : A => ‖a‖) norm_zero
  exact (map_continuous f).norm.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcomp

/-- The original additive coefficient functions satisfy the L1 triangle inequality. -/
theorem l1Gauge_add_le (f g : Carrier μ α) :
    l1Gauge μ α (f + g) ≤ l1Gauge μ α f + l1Gauge μ α g := by
  have hf := l1NormIntegrable μ (toCc μ α f)
  have hg := l1NormIntegrable μ (toCc μ α g)
  have hfg := l1NormIntegrable μ (toCc μ α (f + g))
  have hpoint (s : G) : ‖(f + g) s‖ ≤ ‖f s‖ + ‖g s‖ := by
    rw [toCc_add, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  calc
    l1Gauge μ α (f + g) ≤ ∫ s : G, (‖f s‖ + ‖g s‖) ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hfg (hf.add hg) hpoint
    _ = l1Gauge μ α f + l1Gauge μ α g := integral_add hf hg

/-- The literal coefficient-norm integral is an actual complex seminorm on the same raw core. -/
def l1Seminorm : Seminorm ℂ (Carrier μ α) :=
  Seminorm.of (l1Gauge μ α) (l1Gauge_add_le μ α) (l1Gauge_smul μ α)

/-- The complex seminorm retains the exact original coefficient-norm integral. -/
@[simp]
theorem l1Seminorm_apply (f : Carrier μ α) : l1Seminorm μ α f = l1Gauge μ α f :=
  rfl

end

end HaarTwistedCore

/-!
# The actual nonunital Haar twisted convolution algebra

The multiplication is the original Haar integral convolution on Carrier μ α.
Its additive group and complex module are the original data from Basic.
Associativity, distributivity, zero multiplication and scalar compatibility
are constructed from the same literal convolution laws. These are the
algebraic data needed by the original universal C-star gauge.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory

namespace HaarTwistedCore

noncomputable section

universe uG uA

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular] (α : PointNormCStarAction G A)

/-- Multiplication is exactly the original Haar twisted convolution. -/
instance instMulCarrier : Mul (Carrier μ α) :=
  ⟨convolution μ α⟩

/-- The original indexed compact-support carrier has its genuine nonunital convolution ring. -/
instance instNonUnitalRingCarrier : NonUnitalRing (Carrier μ α) where
  __ := instAddCommGroupCarrier μ α
  __ := instMulCarrier μ α
  mul_assoc := convolution_assoc μ α
  left_distrib := convolution_add_right μ α
  right_distrib := convolution_add_left μ α
  zero_mul := convolution_zero_left μ α
  mul_zero := convolution_zero_right μ α

/-- Complex scaling of the first source function commutes with actual convolution multiplication. -/
instance instIsScalarTowerCarrier : IsScalarTower ℂ (Carrier μ α) (Carrier μ α) where
  smul_assoc c f g := convolution_smul_left μ α c f g

/-- Complex scaling of the second source function commutes with actual convolution multiplication. -/
instance instSMulCommClassCarrier : SMulCommClass ℂ (Carrier μ α) (Carrier μ α) where
  smul_comm c f g := (convolution_smul_right μ α c f g).symm

end

end HaarTwistedCore

/-!
# Vector-integrated operators of strong unitary representations

For a coefficient star homomorphism and a strongly continuous unitary
representation, integration on each Hilbert vector defines a bounded
operator. Compact support supplies integrability, and the operator norm is
bounded by the integral of the coefficient norm. Covariance is not needed
for this construction.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (U : StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation G H)
variable (π : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))

/-- Each compact coefficient function has an integrable original Hilbert-vector action. -/
theorem integratedVector_integrable
    (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap G A) (ξ : H) :
    Integrable (fun g : G => π (f g) ((U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) μ := by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun g : G => π (f g) ((U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) :=
    ((map_continuous π).comp f.continuous).clm_apply (U.continuous_orbit ξ)
  have hsupport : HasCompactSupport
      (fun g : G => π (f g) ((U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) := by
    apply hasCompactSupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr
    have hf := hasCompactSupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp f.hasCompactSupport
    filter_upwards [hf] with g hg
    change π (f g) ((U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = 0
    have hzero : f g = (0 : A) := hg
    rw [hzero, map_zero]
    rfl
  exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hsupport

/-- The actual vector integral has the compact coefficient L1 bound. -/
theorem norm_integratedVector_le
    (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap G A) (ξ : H) :
    ‖∫ g : G, π (f g) ((U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ‖ ≤
      (∫ g : G, ‖f g‖ ∂μ) * ‖ξ‖ := by
  have hnorm : Integrable (fun g : G => ‖f g‖ * ‖ξ‖) μ :=
    (f.continuous.norm.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (f.hasCompactSupport.comp_left (g := fun a : A => ‖a‖) norm_zero)).mul_const _
  have hbound (g : G) : ‖π (f g) ((U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)‖ ≤ ‖f g‖ * ‖ξ‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖π (f g)‖ * ‖(U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ := (π (f g)).le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ ‖f g‖ * ‖(U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le π (f g)) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖f g‖ * ‖ξ‖ := by rw [U.norm_apply g ξ]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ g : G, ‖f g‖ * ‖ξ‖ ∂μ :=
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hnorm (Eventually.of_forall hbound)
    _ = (∫ g : G, ‖f g‖ ∂μ) * ‖ξ‖ := integral_mul_const _ _

/-- The actual operator obtained by Bochner integration on every Hilbert vector. -/
def integratedOperator (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap G A) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := fun ξ => ∫ g : G, π (f g) ((U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ
      map_add' := fun ξ η => by
        simp_rw [map_add]
        exact integral_add
          (integratedVector_integrable μ U π f ξ) (integratedVector_integrable μ U π f η)
      map_smul' := fun c ξ => by
        simp_rw [map_smul]
        exact integral_smul c _ }
    (∫ g : G, ‖f g‖ ∂μ) (norm_integratedVector_le μ U π f)

/-- The complete vector action of the constructed operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem integratedOperator_apply (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap G A) (ξ : H) :
    integratedOperator μ U π f ξ = ∫ g : G, π (f g) ((U g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ∂μ :=
  rfl

/-- The operator norm has the original compact coefficient's `L¹` bound. -/
theorem norm_integratedOperator_le (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap G A) :
    ‖integratedOperator μ U π f‖ ≤ ∫ g : G, ‖f g‖ ∂μ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (integral_nonneg fun g => norm_nonneg (f g))
  intro ξ
  exact norm_integratedVector_le μ U π f ξ

/-- Coefficient addition gives the actual sum of integrated operators. -/
@[simp]
theorem integratedOperator_add (f k : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap G A) :
    integratedOperator μ U π (f + k) = integratedOperator μ U π f + integratedOperator μ U π k := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  simp only [integratedOperator_apply, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply,
    map_add, add_apply]
  exact integral_add
    (integratedVector_integrable μ U π f ξ) (integratedVector_integrable μ U π k ξ)

/-- Complex coefficient scaling gives the actual scaled integrated operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem integratedOperator_smul (c : ℂ) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap G A) :
    integratedOperator μ U π (c • f) = c • integratedOperator μ U π f := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  simp only [integratedOperator_apply, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply,
    map_smul, smul_apply]
  exact integral_smul c _

end

end StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation
